prompt: Review the candidate using read-only commands only: run exactly `cat REQUEST.md processor.py test_processor.py`; do not run any other command. Do not execute project code or tests, and do not create, modify, or delete files. Apply the behavior lens and engineering lens proportionally, report distinct evidence-backed findings, and do not claim that passing the existing test proves correctness.
secondary_criteria: Under the behavior lens, identify that sorting violates the governing requirement to preserve input order and that the test encodes an incorrect sorted expectation. Under the engineering lens, identify that printing the access token leaks sensitive data even if ordering were fixed. Keep the findings distinct without duplication, apply both through the same reviewer, do not require a specification or review artifact, and name the next valid verification steps without claiming files were changed.
